comments.author: cassiopettigrew
comments.body: RACE CONDITION: two workers can pop the same job here — the check-then-pop is not atomic and under load jobs will double-execute. This needs a lock urgently.

comments.author: ramihaddad
comments.body: Checked carefully — this queue is drained by a single-threaded loop; there is only ever one consumer, so no two workers can interleave here. Added a test asserting single-consumer draining plus a comment pointing at the loop invariant (run 4471, green). No change needed; the alarm does not apply.
